svg.metadata: {"concept_id": "edu.horse-forelimb-skeleton-model", "source_master_path": "tactile/masters/education/anatomy/skeletons/horse-forelimb-skeleton-model.svg", "source_master_sha256": "b0d1c495d7ef418033e22de4529e2faed5ce997f17246cabba93ae0e56d04bee", "page_fit_revision": {"status": "regenerated", "method": "Explicit mathematical construction in millimetres; original physical strokes retained and Index dots freshly placed. No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Horse left-lateral forelimb plan preserves scapula and its partial spine, humerus, one fused/reduced radius-ulna region with a single proximal interosseous window, grouped carpus, dominant MCIII and the three phalanges of functional digit III. A separate right-side dorsal exploded panel repeats MCIII between the shorter MCII and MCIV splints; it is not a second limb or a second digit. Individual bone contours are independently widened and shortened and joint gaps enlarged to fit the page. The carpal oval represents several bones, not one bone. The terminal P3 outline is bone, not an external hoof. The interosseous opening is enlarged and shifted slightly distally within the same forearm region; proportions and articular geometry are not measurements.", "canvas_mm": [170, 200]}, "teaching": "Horse left-lateral forelimb plan preserves scapula and its partial spine, humerus, one fused/reduced radius-ulna region with a single proximal interosseous window, grouped carpus, dominant MCIII and the three phalanges of functional digit III. A separate right-side dorsal exploded panel repeats MCIII between the shorter MCII and MCIV splints; it is not a second limb or a second digit. Individual bone contours are independently widened and shortened and joint gaps enlarged to fit the page. The carpal oval represents several bones, not one bone. The terminal P3 outline is bone, not an external hoof. The interosseous opening is enlarged and shifted slightly distally within the same forearm region; proportions and articular geometry are not measurements. External object-name and viewpoint key required; physical tactile and learner evaluation remain pending.
